project: Hardcoded ADR False Positives & Noun-to-Module Leakage Audit

project: Task BDD Auth Invariance & Architecture Template Rigidity Audit

project: Undebated Architectural Claims & Lexical Scale Triggers Audit
summary: Architecture decisions were passed downstream to coding agents without formal challenge/evidence auditing, allowing invalid monolith proposals for 50k req/sec systems or unbacked microservice proposals for simple monoliths to go unchallenged.

project: Un-gated Downstream Compilation & Conflated Artifact Triad Status Audit
summary: Compiler compiled LLD components and tasks despite HLD validation errors or PROPOSED/PENDING ADRs, and conflated EpistemicStatus, ValidationStatus, and ApprovalStatus into single string properties.

project: Un-enforced FSM Transition Controls & Automatic Approval Inferences Audit
summary: 19-state FSM allowed phase transitions to CODING despite blocked artifact governance, and ApprovalStatus was automatically inferred as APPROVED from absence of blocking ADRs without explicit receipts.

project: Untrusted Boolean Approval Override Bypass Audit
summary: Runtime created untrusted boolean override flags ('all_approved': true) in approvals.json which bypassed blocked artifact governance states without cryptographically verifiable approval receipts.

project: Un-keyed Digest Signatures, Stale Content Replay, & Un-scoped Policy Auto-Approval Audit
summary: Approval signatures lacked HMAC secret keying allowing local tampering, approval receipts lacked content hash binding allowing stale approvals to be replayed across mutated ADRs, and high-risk decisions (topology, security) were auto-approved under generic deterministic policies.

project: Workspace Key Leakage, Partial Field Hashing, Missing Version Anti-Replay, & Fail-Open Default Audit
summary: Governance secret keys were generated inside the workspace allowing code execution access, content hashes covered only 3 fields allowing stale approvals across mutated metadata, version anti-replay was unenforced, and default execution mode failed open.

project: Document-Level Generic Debate & Un-Signed Decision Audit
summary: Debate engine operated over whole documents rather than fine-grained engineering claims, lacked multi-perspective Architect and Skeptic challenge auditing, lacked trade-off and blast-radius scoring, and produced unsigned decision output.

project: Hardcoded String Debate Rules, Un-Decomposed Claims, & Default Auto-Acceptance Audit
summary: Debate engine relied on hardcoded title string matches, lacked structured claim decomposition (premises, rationale, falsifiers), lacked evidence quality scoring, auto-accepted decisions on absence of challenges, and mutated ADRs without preserving versioned ADR v1 -> v2 revisions.

project: Evidence Fabrication for Missing Evidence, Synthetic Alternative Over-counting, & Permissive UNKNOWN Gates
summary: Debate engine assigned non-zero quality score (~0.65) to missing/fallback evidence ('Default architectural inference'), counted synthetic fallback alternatives as grounded exploration, mistook entity nodes for domain actors in security challenges, and treated UNKNOWN challenge dimensions as PASS.

project: Architecture Style Misclassified as NFR Evidence, Single-Module False Modularity PASS, & Approval Override Loophole
summary: Debate engine misclassified monolithic architecture topology as proof of Data Consistency PASS, treated single HLD module as proof of Modularity PASS, allowed existing approval receipts to substitute for grounded alternative exploration, and used static high-risk dimension assignments.

project: Mutually Exclusive Risk Classification Trees & Conflation of Requirement Presence with Architecture Satisfaction
summary: Debate engine assigned only single mutually exclusive risk domains to complex multi-domain decisions, conflated requirement presence (keywords) with architectural satisfaction proof, and accepted un-compared candidate alternatives.

project: Un-Evaluated Alternative Counting Bug & Security PASS Dual-Evidence Bypass
summary: Debate engine counted grounded alternatives without comparison rationales as explored alternatives, and returned PASS for Security & Authorization gate even when explicit security requirements were missing.
